name: SGLang Self-Hosted LLM Serving
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 open-source framework for self-hosted LLM and multimodal inference serving; no software license fees or hosted API request quota.
watch_out: Requires your own GPU/CPU servers and model weights; compute, electricity, cloud GPU and storage may cost money. Model-specific licenses and commercial rights are separate from SGLang's Apache-2.0 code license.
